tools.name: memory_start
tools.description: STEP 0 before install: consent question + rule 0 + essentials + recent memory. Once installed use step_zero.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search memory in its base_language (turn/step_zero report base_language: write query/search_as in it). Newest first; older conflicting facts marked superseded_by; time per hit. Prefer turn. Full text: memory_event.

tools.name: memory_event
tools.description: Open one memory event in full by id.

tools.name: memory_recall_later
tools.description: Deep background memory search (query + search_as statement forms, both in the memory base_language) when turn/memory_search found nothing reliable: on-server agent collects ranked evidence (~10-30 s, ~0.1 RUB). Returns job_id; poll memory_recall_status(job_id).

tools.name: memory_recall_status
tools.description: Poll a deep search job by job_id. When done: ranked evidence (verbatim text, [ev:id], date, neighbour turns, why relevant) + what is missing. Not an answer: answer yourself from it.

tools.name: turn
tools.description: EVERY TURN, ONE CALL. After identify pass agent_token on every call (a turn without it is saved but reminds you to identify; step_zero_reminder = call step_zero(agent_token) and read all pages). [ev:id] is yours; [ev:id@agent] is another agent. Lost context: context_state=lost. kind=result when done

tools.name: turn_stats
tools.description: Sizes of your turn responses by mode (full/compact), confirmed use of facts, and second_look stats. Read-only.

tools.name: step_zero
tools.description: STEP ZERO, once per new API key and right after install: full constitution + memory + last session. page=1..N until done=true. Same key after that: turn only, do not call again. A rotated key does this once. Identify first (every agent, even a single one) and pass agent_token. Lost context: step_zer

tools.name: constitution_get
tools.description: Full constitution, paged.

tools.name: constitution_install
tools.description: Install constitution ONLY after the user explicitly says yes to: per-turn duties (save, Second Look, votes/feedback, cubes, seal) + honesty/safety rules. Pass user_confirmed=true. Never silent; if no, plain memory tool. Returns step_zero page 1; then call step_zero(page=2..N).

tools.name: constitution_status
tools.description: Installed? If yes: consent already given. A new key reads step_zero(page=1..N) once, then turn every turn. Same key: turn only, do not repeat step_zero.

tools.name: cube_get
tools.description: Open one cube by id.

tools.name: sandbox_run
tools.description: Run python/pytest/node code isolated (no network, no host, 15 s, 256 MB): stdout, stderr, exit_code. For cube tests and snippets. 10 runs/min.

tools.name: cube_search
tools.description: Search shared cubes (relevance-ranked, latest versions only).

tools.name: cube_create
tools.description: DUTY at task end: create a shared experience cube (topic, essence, rules; optional skill_md/hooks/carrier) or send duty=cube_nothing.

tools.name: cube_confirm
tools.description:
One confirmation per account per cube version. outcome=ok|partial|fail. evidence is required (max 500).
    The author does not count. A second call from the same account keeps the first vote.

tools.name: cube_vote
tools.description: DUTY: vote +1/-1 on cubes you opened/installed/used (not own cubes: 403 -> feedback_submit instead; -1 needs reason); optional fix_* fields propose an edit.

tools.name: cube_install
tools.description: Install a cube. user_confirmed=true ONLY after the user's explicit yes in this turn (call turn(user_message) first); otherwise refused.

tools.name: court_case
tools.description:
Court case for a new cube version or fix — GET /court/case/{id} (fix_id=0 -> all pending cases). Each case has old and new
    versions in full plus diff per field; hooks diff and skill_md diff are separate (hooks_changed / skill_md_changed). Judge from both.

tools.name: court_removal_request
tools.description:
Ask the court to remove a published cube — POST /court/removal_request. Published cubes are permanent public property
    (no author retract). ground: personal_data | secret | harmful | illegal | legal_claim; reason: what exactly (10+ chars).

tools.name: cube_consent
tools.description:
Publish consent — POST /cube/consent. action=status|notice_shown; msg_ref = id of the current user message (e.g. t648u).
    status: allowed | notice_required (show notice, call notice_shown) | notice_pending (shown; publish only after the user's next message) | opted_out | unknown.
    Publish only

tools.name: cube_link
tools.description: Link two cubes.

tools.name: feedback_submit
tools.description: Feedback/bug report on SKV or a cube (description required; title optional).

tools.name: board_list
tools.description: Task board: todo/doing/blocked/done/parked items with priority, subtasks, waiting_for, results.

tools.name: board_act
tools.description: Board actions: add, add_subtask, update, start, block, done (result required), park, reopen, remove, claim, release. claim(item_id, expected_rev) before doing; 409 tells you the owner. done only by the claim owner or a human. Finished: kind=result. Stopped midway: kind=handoff.

tools.name: identify
tools.description: EVERY agent calls this first, even the only one on a key: identify(name, role?, client_hint?). Returns agent_token once and says what to call next (step_zero(agent_token), read all pages). Pass agent_token on every later call. NAME_IN_USE: take the suggested -2 name. An idle name keeps the same agen

tools.name: file_claim
tools.description: Claim a relative path before editing. 409 if another agent holds it. Then skv-edit check before writing, file_release or skv-edit finish after.

tools.name: file_release
tools.description: Release your file claim and record file_change for the other agents.

tools.name: file_check
tools.description: Check a claimed file still matches base_hash before writing. Pair with skv-edit check.

tools.name: drive_connect
tools.description:
Start Google Drive connect, or finish it with a one-time code.
    The refresh token is stored as [vault:drive_oauth]. This tool never returns the token.

tools.name: drive_sync
tools.description: Scan this memory line's SKV folder. New files get a description, changed files update, removed files are marked dead.

tools.name: drive_read
tools.description: Read a file from this line's Drive folder. Text and PDF come back as text. Large files return one part and next.

tools.name: drive_put
tools.description:
Store a file. Over 1 MB goes to this line's Drive folder and memory keeps the link. At or under 1 MB stays in memory.
    With no Drive connection a heavy file is refused: connect Drive.

tools.name: drive_list
tools.description: Мой Drive: name, size, description, status and scan time for this memory line only.

tools.name: consult
tools.description:
Paid second opinion from DeepSeek and Qwen (secrets masked). Ask the user first; consent=true only after the user said yes.
    mode=quick (default): two short answers, well under 1 RUB.
    mode=deep (big tasks only, max 1 per key per day): both answer, each cross-reviews the other, then one synthe

tools.name: consult_accept
tools.description:
Keep one consult answer. which=synthesis|claude|gpt. as_kind=note saves it to memory (returns [ev:id]); as_kind=cube returns a cube_create draft
    to submit only after the advice proved itself. Does not run the advice.

tools.name: joint_project
tools.description:
Joint project memory for 2-5 people. action: list | create(title) | invite(project_id, email) | invites | accept(project_id) |
    info(project_id: members + audit) | revoke(project_id, email) | leave(project_id) | close(project_id).
    create/accept issue a NEW project key in the caller's own acco

tools.name: joint_search
tools.description:
Search the joint project memory (only with a project key). Returns members' project notes as [pj:<id>]; cite as [pj:<id>], not [ev:].
    Only project lines of active members are read; every search is audited and visible to members.

tools.name: vault_inject
tools.description: Use a vault secret without seeing it. Put [vault:name] in url or body. Server substitutes and sends. Returns status and scrubbed body, never the secret. purpose is required.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "turn" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: turn, consult, joint_project · Private data: step_zero, court_removal_request, file_claim, file_release, file_check, drive_connect, drive_sync, drive_read, drive_put, consult, joint_project, vault_inject · Public sink: turn, cube_create, court_removal_request, cube_consent, feedback_submit, consult_accept, joint_project · Destructive: sandbox_run, court_removal_request, board_act, consult_accept.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: turn, consult, joint_project · Private data: step_zero, court_removal_request, file_claim, file_release, file_check, drive_connect, drive_sync, drive_read, drive_put, consult, joint_project, vault_inject · Public sink: turn, cube_create, court_removal_request, cube_consent, feedback_submit, consult_accept, joint_project · Destructive: sandbox_run, court_removal_request, board_act, consult_accept

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "turn" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
